author: NovaLikesPvP
body:
First, this appeal is from Mango, Please don´t answer it, Thank You!


Well, I will start this appeal telling all the events that happen before I get banned, Thank you for your attetion!


(15-09-2015)

I was searching a team to "vs" on Scrimage, Then PokerFace offered to make a "ts team" and make a Ethernal Cross vs TS Guys Scrimmage, I said " Okay ".

[15-09-2015 21:22:22] Aki | PokerFace: If nobody scrims u i can try make a teamspeak team
[15-09-2015 21:22:24] ❖Nova❖ #RoadTo2K: please

Then, We played a Scrimage on Senex1.
At that moment happened a lot of Racial Slurs and spam, But we ( My team and I ) Tolerated.
When we where finishing the scrimage, People like YouCantCme Started to say a lot of slurs like " Pedro ( Pedro is from our team 9 " You are the king of the beaners LOL ", And more things, ( I had them [Screenshots[ ).
So, We started to get really salty ( My team and I ) And YouCantCMe said other racial slur and we get really angry, So, I texted to YouCantCMe " Hey YouCantCMe, See this link, its really funny like you °/#(24%/)29%0 " At I sended him the "Screamer" Link.
I talked then with that guys and anyone opened the "screamer link" Except PokerFace, He thought It was a "Keylogger" but I explained him and it get calmed.

The next gyazos are from some Racial Slurs.

YouCantCMe : https://gyazo.com/804bf7c094791254b3971fafc6f60737
YouCantCMe: https://gyazo.com/36dfdee64ad52d92a4dc70f319c5cd8e
YouCantCMe Spaming: https://gyazo.com/a6457255f8895cfcb6532a385e0d88e1
Other Lol..: https://gyazo.com/cb3d216a4fc2c02d8c0d5fcc64c41b2f



[15-09-2015]

I talked with GrapeSmoothie, ( After I get banned ) And he told me that It wasn´t necesary to make a Appeal and he would unban me after the StaffMeeting.



[15-09-2015 23:31:57] Grape | Greg :I: yea don't get so slow
[15-09-2015 23:32:21] Grape | Greg :I: I notice as I said there isn't a post about the scrim rules of which I will discuss in the next senior meeting
[15-09-2015 23:32:32] Grape | Greg :I: Don't expect you and your friend to stay banned
[15-09-2015 23:32:57] Grape | Greg :I: Just sit back and wait for me to work this out and solve this
[15-09-2015 23:43:27] ❖Nova❖ #RoadTo2K: Do I appeal?
[15-09-2015 23:43:34] ❖Nova❖ #RoadTo2K: Or It is not necesary?
[16-09-2015 0:17:53] ❖Nova❖ #RoadTo2K: Grape?
[16-09-2015 0:40:39] Grape | Greg :I: Not necessary


[16-09-2015]

I was leaving that day ( Up to Saturday ) for the "Fiestas Patrias" On my Country, Chile.
On that day A UK Guy called Denstar_ Apply for joining my team, Ethernal Cross, Im the only leader on
Ethernal Cross that talk english "fluently" and I decided that It wasn´t really "bad" to Use my other private account for testing him on Avicus because I like see players how they play on Avicus and not on others servers.
I thought It wasn´t really "bad" because anyway I will get unban on some days, And specting him on 1 match on Senex1 wouldn´t make nothing.
The I got banned of "Ban Evasion" When I just played some minutes.. :S


Personal Self-Criticism

Yes, I was completely Stupid and idiot on Angry with racial slurs, Sending the Screamer Link and "play" when I was "Getting Unbanned" I´m really sorry, I love Avicus and I don´t even wanted to break the rules like that, I´m really Sorry and I really appreciate if You can give me a second chance, Avicus and Ethernal Cross it´s really important for me.

Thanks Mango And Grape For all the support!


Best Wishes

Nova

title: Ban Appeal ( Screamer )  [For Mango]

replies.author: DJ_Barnsey
replies.body:
Hello,

In this appeal i'm getting the vibe that the reason you sent a screamer link is because the other team started to say racial slurs and other inappropriate things.

To me this is not an excuse to put a miss-leading link in-game(screamer)
If the other team were to say inappropriate things the best coarse of action would be to report. Not be "salty" and send screamers.

On another note. I'm not sure why you would also "Ban evade" if Grape said that he would attempt to fix the situation. This situation without the Ban evasion could be fixable, but adding on the punishment of Ban evading i find it hard that you would be able to get your punishment appealed. You really should of waited to be un-banned before logging into another account.

So this appeal is Denied. 

Regards,
Saladman, Senior Mod.

replies.author: Mango_
replies.body:
Hello,

After investigating the situation and the reasoning behind evading the ban, I have decided to revoke the above response and appeal this infraction. We apologise for the misunderstanding but hope you have learned from this situation. If anything similar happens in the future, it is unlikely you be be appealed again. Please make the most of this opportunity.

Regards,
Mango_
